breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0005 with 720 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.3.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that 720 time steps at dt=0.0005 would result in a final time of T=0.36, which contradicts the specified final time of T=0.3. The agent corrected the number of time steps to 600 (since 0.3 / 0.0005 = 600), which matches the ground truth.
